headline: How OpenAI Keeps ChatGPT Fast Amid Rapid AI Development
summary: An InfoQ presentation details the performance engineering practices OpenAI uses to keep ChatGPT responsive even as agentic coding features and model complexity grow rapidly. It covers techniques for balancing latency, throughput, and reliability as AI systems scale under increasing user and workload demands.
why_it_matters: As an AI Engineer building LLM applications on ServiceNow, understanding how leading labs manage performance at scale gives you practical patterns—like latency optimization and load management—that you can apply to your own agentic AI implementations, directly supporting your goal of becoming an AI Application Engineer.

headline: Cloudflare's 'Precursor' Uses Behavioral Analysis to Spot Bots and AI Agents
summary: Cloudflare has introduced Precursor, a system that continuously analyzes behavioral patterns to distinguish between human users, bots, and AI agents accessing web services. Rather than relying on static signatures, it monitors ongoing interaction patterns to make real-time classification decisions.
why_it_matters: With AI agents increasingly interacting with web services and enterprise platforms, this kind of behavioral detection is directly relevant to building and securing LLM-based applications—helping you anticipate how your own AI agents might be classified or throttled by external systems, and informing design choices for agent-based tools you build.
